title: Bmal1, Clock, and Rev-erb perturbations converge on a 151 TH clock-output and synaptic branch
exact_observed_result: Bmal1 and Clock perturbations lowered core clock outputs such as Dbp and Nr1d2 in responsive thalamic/midbrain classes; Nr1d1 perturbation induced Npas2, Cry2, Dbp, Ciart, and Nfil3 plus neuronal genes in 151 TH; and Nr1d2 loss recurrently induced Nr1d1 with weak reciprocal Nr1d1-to-Nr1d2 compensation.
biological_interpretation: The 151 TH circadian feedback loop is recoverable by CRISPRi but asymmetric: BMAL1/CLOCK and REV-ERB perturbations share part of the branch while CRY1, CRY2, and ROR-family perturbations split by marker and polarity.

evidence_records.statistics: Among 2,045 other perturbation targets in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, all-gene score correlations with Bmal1 ranked Nr1d1 first at r=0.347, Clock second at r=0.202, Nr1d2 third at r=0.167, and Rora last/top negative at r=-0.154.
evidence_records.description: Related clock perturbations were the nearest positive and negative score-space neighbors of Bmal1 specifically in the thalamic Prkcd class.

evidence_records.statistics: At FDR<0.05 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Bmal1 had 103 genes, Clock 3, Nr1d1 116, and Rora 278; Bmal1 shared 2 FDR genes with Clock, 41 with Nr1d1, and 19 with Rora. Across the 103 Bmal1 FDR genes, score correlations were r=0.664 with Nr1d1, r=0.778 with Clock, and r=-0.261 with Rora.
evidence_records.description: Overlap and direction among related perturbations in the dominant thalamic response supported convergence with Nr1d1/Clock trends and partial opposition to Rora.

evidence_records.statistics: 355,046 gene-level tests for Bmal1 across 21 cell classes; matched Bmal1-perturbed cells per class ranged from 34 to 152, median 62, total 1,450; 116 DE rows were FDR<0.05 and 302 were nominal p<0.001.
evidence_records.description: Overall coverage and differential-expression yield for the Bmal1 perturbation against matched Non_target controls.

evidence_records.statistics: 152 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; 103 genes FDR<0.05. Top hits by FDR included Dbp logFC -1.601 FDR 3.07e-22, Nr1d2 -1.083 FDR 1.19e-18, Nr1d1 -1.074 FDR 4.70e-18, Adgrb1 -0.622 FDR 8.02e-18, Erc2 +0.628 FDR 1.32e-12, Hrh3 -0.707 FDR 4.23e-11, Npas2 +0.827 FDR 7.99e-11, Grb14 +0.704 FDR 8.46e-10, Pdgfa +0.965 FDR 1.37e-09, and Camkv -1.016 FDR 1.37e-09.
evidence_records.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class carried the dominant broad Bmal1 transcriptional signature.

evidence_records.statistics: All listed genes were FDR<0.05 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: Camkv logFC -1.016 FDR 1.37e-09, Hrh3 -0.707 FDR 4.23e-11, Camk4 +0.580 FDR 9.13e-07, Rims3 -0.391 FDR 2.24e-04, Syt7 -0.249 FDR 0.00282, Shank3 -0.300 FDR 0.00465, Cacna1d +0.328 FDR 0.0167, Ppp3ca +0.273 FDR 0.00388, Ppp3r1 +0.213 FDR 0.0346, and Snap25 +0.149 FDR 0.0407.
evidence_records.description: Beyond clock genes, the strongest Bmal1 signature contained neuronal signaling, synaptic, and calcium-regulated transcripts.

evidence_records.statistics: 142 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; exactly 4 genes were FDR<0.05: Nr1d2 logFC -1.372 FDR 6.52e-22, Dbp -1.288 FDR 1.57e-06, Nr1d1 -1.075 FDR 6.22e-04, and Cry1 +1.123 FDR 0.0411.
evidence_records.description: Midbrain glutamatergic neurons showed a statistically strong but clock-restricted Bmal1 response.

evidence_records.statistics: 115 perturbed cells versus 15,039 controls; 4 genes were FDR<0.05: Nr1d2 logFC -1.089 FDR 1.04e-12, Nr1d1 -0.846 FDR 6.89e-04, Npas2 +0.660 FDR 0.0173, and Camkv -0.537 FDR 0.0177; Dbp was nominal with logFC -0.796, p=2.69e-05, FDR 0.0922.
evidence_records.description: Layer 4/5 intratelencephalic cortical neurons showed a compact Bmal1 response at clock genes plus Camkv.

evidence_records.statistics: Arntl was measurable in all 21 Bmal1 contrasts but had FDR=1.0 in every cell class; the strongest nominal row was 052 Pvalb Gaba with score 2.44, logFC 0.781, p=0.0149; 15 of 21 Arntl scores were positive.
evidence_records.description: The Bmal1/Arntl target transcript itself was not significantly reduced by cells carrying Bmal1 guides.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d2 was negative in 20/21 classes and FDR<0.05 in 8/21, with 13 nominal p<0.001 hits and minimum FDR 6.52e-22; Dbp was negative in 20/21, FDR<0.05 in 2/21, nominal p<0.001 in 10/21, minimum FDR 3.07e-22; Nr1d1 was FDR<0.05 in 3/21 and nominal p<0.001 in 5/21.
evidence_records.description: Bmal1 perturbation recurrently repressed canonical circadian output and feedback genes, especially Nr1d2 and Dbp.

evidence_records.statistics: Five cell classes had exactly one FDR<0.05 Bmal1 hit and that hit was Nr1d2: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut, n=38, logFC -1.364, FDR 1.16e-04; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, n=65, logFC -1.122, FDR 2.76e-04; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, n=60, logFC -0.972, FDR 0.00564; 145 MH-LH TH Glut, n=34, logFC -1.191, FDR 0.00209; 191 MB P MY GABA, n=74, logFC -1.265, FDR 4.49e-10.
evidence_records.description: Several cell classes converted the Bmal1 perturbation into a single highly sensitive Nr1d2 response without a broader FDR-significant signature.

evidence_records.statistics: 141 Clock cells versus 20353 controls; Nr1d2 logFC=-0.833, FDR=1.30e-13; Dbp logFC=-1.290, FDR=2.05e-6; Tef logFC=-0.661, FDR=0.00151; Per3 logFC=-0.918, FDR=0.0221; Hlf logFC=-0.870, p=3.85e-5, FDR=0.134; Cry1 logFC=0.982, p=1.71e-4, FDR=0.373; Arntl logFC=0.889, p=0.00135, FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: Clock perturbation in midbrain glutamatergic cells strongly repressed canonical clock-output genes and nominally induced the partner-arm gene Arntl.

evidence_records.statistics: 162 Clock cells versus 23679 controls; Dbp logFC=-1.030, FDR=1.36e-11; Nr1d2 logFC=-0.378, FDR=2.25e-4; Tef logFC=-0.517, FDR=5.35e-4; Per1 logFC=-0.341, p=3.14e-5, FDR=0.108; Nr1d1 logFC=-0.285, p=0.00149, FDR=1.0; Cry1 logFC=0.427, p=0.0217, FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: Clock perturbation in thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic cells produced a multi-gene circadian response headed by Dbp, Nr1d2, and Tef.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d2 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 143 cells; Nr1d1 logFC=0.520, FDR=1.44e-5; Dbp logFC=0.338, p=0.00135. Nr1d2 perturbation in 155 MB Glut: 137 cells; Nr1d1 logFC=0.569, p=3.62e-4; Dbp logFC=0.449, p=0.00211; Arntl logFC=0.838, p=0.00339.
evidence_records.description: Loss of the downstream REV-ERBβ/Nr1d2 node produced expression changes reciprocal to Clock/Bmal1 loss in the two main Clock-responsive cell types.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d2 perturbation upregulated Nr1d1 in 217 P MY Pineal Glut (32 cells, logFC=1.562, FDR=0.00900), 054 CNU-MGE GABA (66 cells, logFC=1.098, p=3.40e-4), 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA (53 cells, logFC=1.009, p=6.18e-4), and 191 MB P MY GABA (57 cells, logFC=0.806, p=0.00651); Dbp was also nominally up in 217 and 066 with p<=0.00167.
evidence_records.description: The Nr1d2-to-Nr1d1 reciprocal relationship recurred outside the two highest-confidence Clock cell types.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d1 was measured in all 23 Nr1d1-perturbation cell-type tests; 22/23 logFC values were positive and 0/23 were FDR < 0.05. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Nr1d1 logFC was 0.2459 with score 3.172, nominal p=0.00151, FDR=0.1368 in 205 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls.
evidence_records.description: Target-transcript rows for the Nr1d1 perturbation show no multiple-testing-significant depletion of the target RNA.

evidence_records.statistics: 116 genes reached FDR < 0.05 in 205 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 94 had positive scores and 22 had negative scores. Top adjusted results included Erc2 logFC 0.706, FDR=3.33e-25; Pdgfa logFC 1.048, FDR=1.35e-16; Tspan14 logFC 0.623, FDR=1.52e-10; Cacna2d3 logFC 0.715, FDR=5.11e-10; L1cam logFC -0.272, FDR=6.60e-7.
evidence_records.description: The only Nr1d1 cell-type stratum with a large FDR-controlled response was the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: The 22 Nr1d1-assayed classes outside 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut had 0 genes at FDR < 0.05. The best non-151 adjusted result was Camkv in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut with FDR=0.138; every other non-151 class had minimum FDR >= 0.220, and 15/22 had minimum FDR=1.0.
evidence_records.description: Most assayed neuronal classes showed no FDR-controlled transcriptome response to Nr1d1 perturbation.

evidence_records.statistics: 135 Cry1-perturbed cells versus 23679 non-target controls; Per2 score 4.842, logFC 0.757, nominal p=1.28e-6, FDR=0.0221; rank 1/17259 by nominal p and absolute score.
evidence_records.description: Per2 was the strongest and only FDR-significant transcript in the Cry1 signature in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.

evidence_records.statistics: 371818 Cry1 differential-expression rows across 22 cell types; 1 row had FDR<0.05; 21/22 cell types had 0 FDR<0.05 genes; non-151 minimum FDR values were all >=0.454.
evidence_records.description: Genome-wide Cry1 responses were sparse after multiple-testing correction over the assayed cell-type panel.

evidence_records.statistics: 22 Cry1 cell types; 1358 total Cry1-perturbed cells; per-cell-type Cry1 n=23-135, median 58; non-target controls n=3465-23679; 16428-17443 measured genes per test.
evidence_records.description: Cry1 contrasts were based on modest perturbation cell numbers relative to thousands of controls.

evidence_records.statistics: 254 Cry2-perturbed cells versus 23679 matched controls; Nr1d1 score -7.014, logFC -0.559, p=2.32e-12, FDR=3.97e-08; Cry2 score -6.917, logFC -0.535, p=4.61e-12, FDR=3.97e-08; Dbp score -5.944, logFC -0.541, p=2.78e-09, FDR=1.60e-05.
evidence_records.description: The only multi-gene FDR-significant Cry2 response occurs in the thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class and consists of a downregulated clock-output module plus the target transcript.

evidence_records.statistics: 371818 Cry2 tests across 22 cell types produced 4 rows at FDR<0.05: 3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 1 in 191 MB P MY GABA; the remaining 20 profiled cell types had 0 FDR<0.05 rows.
evidence_records.description: FDR-significant Cry2 responses are sparse and concentrated in a single thalamic glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: The Cry2 row was present in all 22 Cry2 cell-type tests; logFC was negative in 21 of 22 cell types, two-sided sign-test p=1.10e-05, median logFC=-0.319, median Wilcoxon score=-1.876; 11/22 had nominal p<0.05 and 7/22 had p<0.01, but only 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut passed FDR<0.05 for Cry2 itself.
evidence_records.description: The guide produced a recurrent downward shift of the target transcript, but robust multiple-testing-corrected target engagement was confined to one cell type.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d1 FDR hits after Nr1d2 perturbation: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 143 cells, score 6.137799, logFC 0.519723, p=8.37e-10, FDR=1.44e-05; 052 Pvalb Gaba, 107 cells, score 5.769503, logFC 0.959292, p=7.95e-09, FDR=1.33e-04; 217 P MY Pineal Glut, 32 cells, score 5.012839, logFC 1.561956, p=5.36e-07, FDR=0.008995.
evidence_records.description: The only FDR<0.05 genes in the Nr1d2 perturbation slice were Nr1d1 rows in three cell groups.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d1 was nominally increased after Nr1d2 perturbation in 11/22 cell groups at p<0.05; it ranked as the top positive gene in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 217 P MY Pineal Glut, 054 CNU-MGE GABA, and 155 MB Glut, and ranked second in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA.
evidence_records.description: Recurrence and rank of Nr1d1 induction beyond the three FDR-significant groups.

evidence_records.statistics: Clock-associated rows under Nr1d1 perturbation were Npas2 logFC 0.606, FDR=4.30e-7; Cry2 logFC 0.375, FDR=1.54e-4; Dbp logFC 0.407, FDR=0.00243; Ciart logFC 0.595, FDR=0.00334; Nfil3 logFC 0.752, FDR=0.00417; Arntl logFC 0.430, FDR=0.0922; Nr1d2 logFC 0.133, FDR=0.774; Clock logFC 0.162, FDR=0.809.
evidence_records.description: Core and clock-output genes show selective, mostly positive changes in the responsive Nr1d1 stratum.

evidence_records.statistics: Nr1d2 perturbation significantly increased Nr1d1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut (logFC 0.520, FDR=1.44e-5, 143 perturbed cells), 052 Pvalb Gaba (logFC 0.959, FDR=1.33e-4, 107 perturbed cells), and 217 P MY Pineal Glut (logFC 1.562, FDR=0.00899, 32 perturbed cells). In the reciprocal Nr1d1 perturbation, Nr1d2 was only nominal in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut (logFC 0.133, nominal p=0.0302, FDR=0.774).
evidence_records.description: The Rev-erb paralog perturbation produced a focal, asymmetric increase of Nr1d1 RNA.

caveats: The culture snapshot has no circadian phase series, so counterintuitive CRY2 and REV-ERB directions should be interpreted as basal endpoint states rather than time-resolved feedback dynamics.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
